appDesc.message: Widen Gemini and ChatGPT with separate width settings. Adjust reading density, font size, and code wrapping in Gemini.

headerSubtitle.message: Make the conversation interface wider and more comfortable

localeCode.description: HTML language tag for this translation.

helpGettingStarted.message: Make Gemini and ChatGPT fit your screen

helpOpenPopup.message: Open Gemini or ChatGPT, then click the Wider Gemini toolbar icon. Use the site buttons to choose which website to adjust.

helpWidthBody.message: Choose px for a fixed width or % to follow the window size. Move the slider or choose a preset. Gemini and ChatGPT save width, limits, and presets separately; each unit has its own presets. Expand Range & presets to edit them. The switch beside the width title pauses widening for that site and restores its original width. Your saved values and presets are kept; Gemini reading settings remain active.

helpCodeBody.message: Gemini only: Turn on Code Auto Wrap to read long lines without as much horizontal scrolling. Turn it off to preserve unbroken code lines.

helpReadingBody.message: Gemini only: Adjust font size from 75% to 200% without zooming the whole page. At Auto density 0, native paragraph gaps and line-height proportions are preserved. Higher density gradually reduces native spacing. Advanced spacing sets exact manual values; Reset spacing returns to Auto at the current density.

helpLiveSettings.message: Changes are saved automatically and apply live to open tabs of the selected website. The two websites keep separate settings; the popup language is shared. Sync across devices depends on your browser’s sync settings.

helpTroubleshootPage.message: Check that you are on gemini.google.com or chatgpt.com and Wider Gemini is enabled with access to that site. Chrome-installed web apps (PWAs) use the same webpages. Native desktop apps and Chrome’s built-in Gemini panel are not supported.

helpTroubleshootRefresh.message: If a setting does not appear after installing or updating the extension, reload the affected page once. An unsupported-layout notice means widening is not applied to the current page, so its original width is preserved. You can also pause widening for just that site using its width switch.

helpTroubleshootReport.message: If the problem continues, note the website, steps to reproduce it, and window size. A screenshot with private content removed can help; mention other extensions that change the page layout.

helpDiagnosticsPrivacy.message: Generate a report to preview before sharing it in an issue. It includes only the extension version, browser major version, platform, Gemini layout settings, and ChatGPT width settings. It contains no chats, page URLs, titles, or custom preset names. Nothing is sent automatically.

helpSupportProject.message: If Wider Gemini helps you, you can star the project or leave an honest review.

helpReportReady.message: Report ready. Review it, then copy it if you want to share it.

helpReportError.message: Could not read settings. Reopen help from the extension and try again.

helpReportCopied.message: Copied. You can paste the report into your issue.

helpReportCopyFallback.message: Copy was unavailable. The report is selected; copy it manually.

taskHint.message: Uses your width limits. Restore returns width, font size, spacing, and code wrapping to their values before the last Apply.

taskPreview.message: Width {width} · Font {font}% · Native spacing · Code wrap {wrap}

taskApplied.message: Applied. Previous settings are saved on this device.

taskSaveError.message: Could not save or load settings. Reopen the popup and try again.

helpTaskBody.message: Gemini only: Choose Long reading, Tables, Code, or Large text, review the settings, then click Apply. These change width, font size, spacing, and code wrapping. Your width limits still apply. Restore previous settings undoes the most recent task preset on this device, even after closing the popup; it replaces any later changes to those settings.

autoSpacingHint.message: Auto follows each message's native spacing. Moving either slider applies both values below manually.

settingsSaveError.message: Could not save settings. Reopen the popup and try again.

widthPaused.message: Widening is paused. Your width and presets are saved.

layoutUnsupported.message: This page layout is not supported yet. Original page width is preserved.

layoutLoading.message: The page is loading. Reopen these settings when it is ready.

layoutUnavailable.message: Page status unavailable. Refresh the page and try again.
